title: Classic Egg Omelette
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_001","title":"Classic Egg Omelette","calories":"250-300","cuisine":"French","difficulty":"Easy","description":"A fluffy French-style omelette with a golden exterior and creamy center.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"egg","quantity":"4","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"milk","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","pink salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","cayenne pepper"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Crack 4 eggs into a bowl and add 2 tablespoons of milk. Whisk vigorously for 30 seconds until light and frothy.","Place a non-stick pan over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter. Let it melt and foam for about 1 minute, tilting the pan to coat evenly.","Pour the egg mixture into the pan. Let it sit undisturbed for 30 seconds until the edges begin to set.","Using a spatula, gently push the cooked edges toward the center while tilting the pan to let uncooked egg flow to the edges. Repeat for 2-3 minutes.","When the top is still slightly moist but the bottom is golden (about 3 minutes total), fold the omelette in half.","Slide onto a warm plate and season with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately."]}

title: Garlic Butter Pasta
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_002","title":"Garlic Butter Pasta","calories":"400-450","cuisine":"Italian","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Simple yet elegant pasta tossed in a rich garlic butter sauce.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"pasta","quantity":"250","unit":"g"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"4","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"butter","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]},{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","red pepper flakes"]},{"name":"dried oregano","alternatives":["dried basil","italian seasoning"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil over high heat. Add 250g pasta and cook according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.","While pasta cooks, peel and thinly slice 4 cloves of garlic. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat.","Add the sliced garlic to the oil and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently, until light golden and fragrant.","Add 3 tablespoons butter to the skillet and swirl until melted and combined with the garlic oil, about 1 minute.","Add the drained pasta to the skillet. Toss vigorously for 1-2 minutes, adding reserved pasta water 2 tablespoons at a time until the sauce coats the pasta evenly.","Season with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of dried oregano. Serve immediately on warm plates."]}

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_003","title":"Chicken Stir-Fry","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"Asian","difficulty":"Medium","description":"Tender chicken pieces with colorful vegetables in a savory soy sauce glaze.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"chicken","quantity":"300","unit":"g"},{"name":"soy sauce","quantity":"3","unit":"tbsp"},{"name":"garlic","quantity":"3","unit":"cloves"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"bell pepper","quantity":"1","unit":"large"}],"spices":[{"name":"black pepper","alternatives":["white pepper","szechuan pepper"]},{"name":"garlic powder","alternatives":["onion powder","ginger powder"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Cut 300g chicken breast into thin strips about 1cm wide. Season with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and a pinch of black pepper. Let marinate for 5 minutes.","Dice the onion and bell pepper into 2cm pieces. Mince the 3 garlic cloves finely.","Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat until smoking, about 2 minutes.","Add the chicken strips in a single layer. Sear without moving for 2 minutes until golden, then flip and cook another 2 minutes. Remove and set aside.","In the same wok, add the onion and bell pepper. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes over high heat until slightly charred but still crisp.","Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Return the chicken to the wok.","Pour in the remaining 2 tablespoons soy sauce and 2 tablespoons water. Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats all ingredients.","Serve immediately over steamed rice or noodles."]}

title: Tomato Rice Pilaf
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_004","title":"Tomato Rice Pilaf","calories":"300-350","cuisine":"Mediterranean","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Fragrant rice cooked with fresh tomatoes and aromatic spices.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"rice","quantity":"200","unit":"g"},{"name":"tomato","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"onion","quantity":"1","unit":"medium"},{"name":"olive oil","quantity":"2","unit":"tbsp"}],"spices":[{"name":"cumin","alternatives":["coriander","caraway"]},{"name":"paprika","alternatives":["smoked paprika","chili powder"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt","kosher salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Rinse 200g rice under cold water 3 times until the water runs clear. Soak in warm water for 10 minutes, then drain.","Dice the onion finely and chop the 2 tomatoes into small cubes.","Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat for 1 minute.","Add the diced onion and saute for 3-4 minutes until translucent and slightly golden.","Add the chopped tomatoes, 1/2 teaspoon cumin, and 1/2 teaspoon paprika. Cook for 3 minutes stirring occasionally until tomatoes soften.","Add the drained rice and stir for 1 minute to coat each grain with the tomato mixture.","Pour in 400ml hot water and 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover tightly and cook for 18-20 minutes without lifting the lid.","Remove from heat and let rest covered for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve."]}

title: Banana Pancakes
recipe_data: {"id":"recipe_005","title":"Banana Pancakes","calories":"350-400","cuisine":"American","difficulty":"Easy","description":"Fluffy golden pancakes studded with sweet mashed banana.","servings":2,"ingredients":[{"name":"banana","quantity":"2","unit":"medium"},{"name":"egg","quantity":"2","unit":"pcs"},{"name":"flour","quantity":"150","unit":"g"},{"name":"milk","quantity":"120","unit":"ml"}],"spices":[{"name":"cinnamon","alternatives":["nutmeg","allspice"]},{"name":"salt","alternatives":["sea salt"]}],"required_extra_ingredients":[],"steps":["Peel 2 bananas and mash them in a large bowl with a fork until mostly smooth with a few small chunks remaining.","Add 2 eggs and 120ml milk to the mashed banana. Whisk until well combined, about 30 seconds.","Add 150g flour, a pinch of salt, and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Stir gently until just combined. Small lumps are fine. Let batter rest for 3 minutes.","Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add 1/2 tablespoon butter and let it melt.","Pour about 3 tablespoons of batter per pancake onto the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set.","Flip carefully and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown on the bottom.","Repeat with remaining batter, adding butter between batches. Stack pancakes on a warm plate.","Serve with sliced banana on top, a drizzle of honey or maple syrup, and a dusting of cinnamon."]}
